title: MeshPack Manifest
description: Root metadata for MeshPack archive. See common.schema.json for shared definitions.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace context. Required for MeshSync ecosystem (REQ-L3-003), optional for standalone use. If present, MUST match the id in ids[ns='meshsync:workspace'].

creator_info.description: Entity that generated the pack. PII note: email may contain personal data — consider redacting for public distribution.

hash_algo.description: Algorithm used for pack_hash and all shard/resource hashes. Implementations SHOULD default to sha256 for maximum compatibility.

pack_hash.description: REFERENCE value only. The authoritative pack_hash MUST be distributed via a detached sidecar file (<name>.meshpack.integrity). Verifiers MUST use the sidecar, not this embedded value. This field is populated after archive creation for informational purposes.

signatures.description: Optional signatures over pack_hash. Informational only in manifest — authoritative signatures are in the sidecar.

shard_list.description: Canonical ordering and hashes of shards. Order defines shard processing sequence.

ids.description: Identifiers for the workspace/library in various namespaces. If workspace_id is set, an entry with ns='meshsync:workspace' MUST be present and match.

generation.description: Provenance and configuration used to generate the pack

partial.description: If true, this is a delta pack referencing a base via base_pack_hash

base_pack_hash.description: Hash of the base pack for delta operations. Required when partial=true.

metamodel_filter.description: Filter applied during export for metamodel context.

import_policy.description: Guidance for conflict handling when importing into another system

extensions.description: Reserved for non-standard metadata. Keys MUST use namespace prefixes (e.g., 'mycompany_feature'). See EXTENSIONS.md.
